entrar.lead: Your saved articles, your submissions and any modules you've purchased.

registro.correoYaTieneCuenta: That email already has an account. If it's yours, sign in instead.
registro.demasiadosIntentos: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
registro.reviseDatos: Check your details: one of them isn't in the expected format.
registro.fallo: Couldn't create the account. Please try again.
registro.lead: Save articles for later, pitch pieces to the newsroom and access the Education modules you purchase. We'll send you a code to confirm your email.
registro.ayudaCorreo: This is where the code to confirm your account will arrive.
registro.nota: Afterward you can complete your profile and upload a photo — you'll need one to sign what you publish.

verificar.subtitulo: Enter the code we sent to your email. If you don't see the message, check your spam folder.
verificar.contrasenaAyuda: The one you chose when signing up. If you don't remember it, sign up again with the same email: you'll get a new code.

solicitarCodigo.enviado: If the email address is valid, we'll send you a new code.
solicitarCodigo.subtitulo: We'll resend a verification code. We don't confirm whether the email exists (privacy).

inicio.confirmeTexto: We sent a code to {correo}. Until you confirm it, you can't save articles, comment or open lessons — it's what keeps anyone from creating accounts with other people's email addresses.
inicio.sinFotoDetalle: You'll need one to sign anything we publish of yours.
inicio.perfilAMedias: Profile incomplete · {n} of 6 details left blank
inicio.perfilAMediasDetalle: All of them are optional; the newsroom uses them to reach you.

usos.guardarTexto: The bookmark on any piece saves it here to read later, from any device.
usos.comentarTexto: Comments are published under your name and are reviewed before they appear. You comment from the piece itself.
usos.proponerTexto: You can send an article or a news item to the newsroom. If it's accepted, it's published with your name and photo.
usos.comprarTexto: Each module is a one-time purchase and access never expires. The first lesson of each one is free to read.

perfil.lead: Your name signs your comments and any pieces we publish of yours. Everything else is optional and only the newsroom sees it.
perfil.ayudaCorreo: Your email identifies the account. To change it, contact us.
perfil.ayudaOcupacion: Appears under your byline if we publish a piece of yours.
perfil.ayudaTelefono: Only so the newsroom can reach you if your submission is accepted.

retrato.tipoNoValido: It has to be a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
retrato.pesaDemasiado: That image is {mb} MB and the limit is 5.
retrato.demasiadosCambios: You've changed your photo several times in a row. Wait a while.
retrato.texto: It's the one that signs the piece if the newsroom publishes a submission of yours. Without it, your article runs without a face.
retrato.elegirImagen: Choose an image for your profile
retrato.pista: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 5 MB

marcadores.verifique: Verify your email to see your bookmarks.
marcadores.lead: Articles you've saved to come back to.
marcadores.vacioTexto: Browse the articles and tap save when one interests you.

meta.descripcion: What you've proposed to the newsroom.

envios.lead: What you've proposed to the newsroom and where each piece stands.
envios.vacioTexto: Propose an analysis or a news item: the newsroom reads it and replies here.

envio.sinContenido: The body of the submission is empty.
envio.notasLead: When the team leaves comments on your proposal, they'll appear here.

envioEditar.yaNoEditable: This proposal can no longer be edited: the newsroom has already taken it.

meta.descripcion: Propose a piece to the newsroom.

envioNuevo.creado: Proposal sent. The newsroom will review it and reply here.

formularioEnvio.articuloPista: Signed analysis, with its regional context.
formularioEnvio.noticiaPista: A recent event, with the source cited.
formularioEnvio.resumenMarcador: Two or three lines summarizing what you're submitting…
formularioEnvio.imagenAyuda: If you have your own photo published online, paste its address here. If not, leave it empty: the newsroom will add one.
formularioEnvio.tituloAyuda: As you'd headline it in the paper. The newsroom may adjust it.
formularioEnvio.contenidoAyuda: Cite your sources in the text, with a link if you have one.
formularioEnvio.faltaResumen: The summary is missing: two or three lines are enough.
formularioEnvio.faltaContenido: The text of the piece is missing.
formularioEnvio.avisoTitulo: What we look for and what happens next
formularioEnvio.avisoQue: Analysis and news about the region's economy, written by you, with your sources cited.
formularioEnvio.avisoDespues: The newsroom reads it and replies in this same account: you'll see its status and any notes left for you.
formularioEnvio.avisoCorregir: Until the newsroom takes it, you can edit it. What you write is saved on this device as you go, in case you close the page halfway.
formularioEnvio.borradorExplica: What you write is saved on this device as you type.
formularioEnvio.borradorSolo: Draft saved on this device at {hora}.
formularioEnvio.recuperado: We restored what you were writing (saved at {hora}).

loMio.fallo: Couldn't load your purchases. Please try again.
loMio.lead: The Education modules you've purchased. Access never expires: they're yours.
loMio.vacioTitulo: You haven't purchased any modules yet
loMio.vacioTexto: When you buy one it will appear here, with its receipt, and you'll be able to open it from right here. Every module has an open first lesson you can read for free.
loMio.fueraDelCatalogo: Out of the catalog right now. It's still yours; contact us if you need it.
loMio.pendienteTexto: The payment was started and we haven't received confirmation yet. If you already paid, it usually takes a few minutes; if you didn't get to pay, you can try again from the module. You won't be charged twice.

fuerza.consejo: A phrase of several words is both safer and easier to remember.

google.noConfirma: Google doesn't confirm that this email is yours. Sign in with your password.

meta.descripcion: The topics you follow and what is new in them.

temas.lead: Follow the topics you care about: what is new in them shows up here and in the «My topics» tab of Latest.
temas.verifique: Verify your email to follow topics.
temas.ninguno: You are not following any topic yet. Pick one below, or press «Follow» next to the topics of any piece.
temas.nadaNuevo: There are no published pieces in your topics yet.

bienvenida.texto: Here's everything that's yours on SurEconomics: what you bought, what you saved to read later, the topics you follow and the pieces you propose to the newsroom. We'll show you where everything is in a minute.

inicio.texto: A summary of your account: what you have, what's left to complete and what you can do.

loMio.texto: The courses and materials you bought, with your receipt and a link to pick up where you left off.

marcadores.texto: The pieces you saved with the bookmark to read later.

temas.texto: Follow the topics you care about and see the latest from each one here.

propuestas.texto: Propose an analysis or a news item to the newsroom and follow its progress: the newsroom replies here.

perfil.texto: Your name, your photo and your details. Only first and last name are required.

ayuda.texto: This button replays this tour. On the busier pages, the «Guide» button explains each one.

queHay.texto: The form to propose a piece to the SurEconomics newsroom: an analysis or a news item written by you.

aviso.texto: What kind of pieces we look for and what happens when you send yours.

formato.p1: Article: an analysis with its context.
formato.p2: News item: a recent event, with the source cited.

titulo.texto: As you'd headline it in the paper. The newsroom may adjust it.

resumen.texto: Two or three lines about what the piece covers. It's the first thing the newsroom reads.

contenido.texto: The full piece. The buttons above add bold, subheadings, lists, quotes and links.

foto.texto: Optional. If you have your own photo published online, paste its address; if not, the newsroom adds one.

acciones.p1: Main button: sends the proposal to the newsroom (or saves your changes, if you're editing one).
acciones.p2: Save draft: keeps it on this device so you can continue later. It also saves itself as you type.
acciones.p3: If something's missing: we tell you right next to that field.

guia.texto: This button opens this guide again.

queHay.texto: Your details on SurEconomics. Only first and last name are required; the rest is up to you.

retrato.texto: Your profile photo. Upload it here; you can change or remove it whenever you like.

nombre.texto: They sign your comments and your proposals. They can't be left empty.

datos.texto: Age, sex, country, city, occupation and phone. They help us know who reads us; you can leave them empty or delete them.

guardar.texto: Changes apply when you press «Save changes».

guia.texto: This button opens this guide again.
